joanna_dx: heads-up — running into an SSL verification error with the Python async client when talking to a Dedicated/private endpoint behind a local HTTP sidecar + custom CA. curl with --cacert works, httpx (async) fails. :confused:

joanna_dx: tiny repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(base_url="https://svc.internal:8443", api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
await client.chat.create("hello")
```

joanna_dx: container mounts /etc/ssl/company-ca.pem. `curl --cacert /etc/ssl/company-ca.pem https://svc.internal:8443/health` -> 200, but python stack shows `ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed`.

oliver_sdk: this smells like httpx trust_env + proxy interaction. httpx will pick up HTTP(S)_PROXY and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE via trust_env by default. If the proxy re-terminates TLS, verification will fail unless the client trusts the proxy CA.

oliver_sdk: workaround I use: construct an SSLContext and disable env parsing so httpx doesn't try to route differently:
```py
import ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/company-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://svc.internal:8443', api_key=..., ssl=ctx, trust_env=False)
```

joanna_dx: that got me past the handshake, thanks. two things to raise: (1) docs/examples only show base_url + token, not this pattern; (2) our retry middleware is currently retrying on SSLError which makes debugging noisy (retries + backoff hide the root cause).

sophie_docs: good catch. onboarding should have a short note: "Dedicated/Private behind proxy: mount CA, and for async flows either set trust_env=False or pass an explicit ssl.SSLContext." I'll add an example under examples/dedicated/proxy-ca (small Dockerfile + compose). include env vars used: HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and show the curl success vs httpx stack.

leo_sre: agree re: retries — verification failures are not transient and should be non-retryable. I'll open an issue to update the retry predicate to exclude ssl.SSLError subclasses that indicate verification errors and improve logs to say "non-retryable SSL verification failure".

oliver_sdk: small SDK follow-ups I can PR: (a) accept ssl: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] in AsyncClient ctor and reflect that in .pyi stubs, (b) type AsyncClient.__aenter__ to return the concrete client type in stubs so context-manager usage is typed, (c) add a unit test that mocks an ssl.SSLError and asserts zero retries.

joanna_dx: I'll draft the example and include the httpx traceback + the curl command output and exact env settings. will link PR here when ready. thanks all! :tada:
